title: Salmon Party Pattee
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped, blanched almonds (brown in fry pan 1st)
1/3 cup chopped green stuffed olives c pimento
directions: Mix well.
Reserve some olives for top.
Use a mold (ring) & if pan is metal, put saran wrap 1st & press it down.
Then put mixture in & refrigerate to "set" a little.
Can be done the day before.
Serve on crackers.
Enjoy!!

title: Seafood Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 package (350 g/12.3 oz) frozen fish fillets*
200 mL (3/4 cup) skim milk cottage cheese
directions: Drain crab and remove any bits of shell or cartilage OR cook and flake fish.
Slice top off the tomatoes. Scoop out and discard the pulp. Invert to drain.
Combine the crab or fish with remaining ingredients and fill each tomato with seafood mixture.
Makes 4 servings.
notes: * or cod, haddock, Boston bluefish, turbot, orange roughy
raw_text:
SEAFOOD STUFFED TOMATOES
1 package (200 g/7 oz) crabmeat, OR
1 package (350 g/12.3 oz) frozen fish fillets*
4 large tomatoes
200 mL (3/4 cup) skim milk cottage cheese
125 mL (1/2 cup) chopped celery
25 mL (2 Tbsp) chopped green onion
15 mL (1 Tbsp) calorie-reduced salad dressing
2 mL (1/2 tsp) salt
Dash pepper
1 mL (1/4 tsp) tarragon
25 mL (2 Tbsp) chopped parsley

Drain crab and remove any bits of shell or cartilage OR cook and flake fish. Slice top off the tomatoes. Scoop out and discard the pulp. Invert to drain. Combine the crab or fish with remaining ingredients and fill each tomato with seafood mixture.
Makes 4 servings.

* or cod, haddock, Boston bluefish, turbot, orange roughy
Courtesy of Fisheries and Oceans
SAFEWAY - CANADA SAFEWAY LIMITED
